sections.text_helper: Section 6.10.9 "FLASH privilege configuration register (FLASH_PRIVCFGR)" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 183.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x03C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register can be read by both privileged and unprivileged access. It can only be written
by privileged mode.
Bits 31:2 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 1 PRIV: Privilege attribute
0: Access to registers is always granted.
1: Access to registers is denied in case of unprivileged access.
Bit 0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
